Zane: Quick shoutout to Lila and Harpreet for covering the support queue while I was OOO yesterday  really appreciated the handoff notes.

Lila: No problem! Harpreet did most of the heavy lifting on the long ticket. I just routed follow-ups.

Harpreet: FYI left the key command I used in the ticket: `support-tool respond --ticket 8421 --template quick-ack`  saved time. Also flagged one item for product follow-up.

Maya: Thanks team  client said "that was fast" in the thread. Big win. GIF: https://giphy.com/gifs/fast-yes-abc

Zane: KUDOS CHAIN  starting it off Lila gets first kudos for tidy notes.

kudos-bot: Zane gave Lila a "Handoff Hero" kudos (reason: clear OOO notes) :sparkles:

Lila: Passing it to Harpreet for the triage work.

kudos-bot: Lila gave Harpreet a "Triage Titan" kudos (reason: resolved tricky ticket) :trophy:

snack-bot: Free coffee in the kitchen to celebrate team wins! :coffee: (third-floor)

Harpreet: I'll add the follow-up to the backlog and assign to @product. Thanks everyone.

Maya: Small request: can we get a short runbook snippet for OOO handoffs? vote: yes/no

Zane: yes

Lila: yes

Harpreet: yes

Maya: Great, I'll draft it and share tomorrow. Thanks again all  feels good to have each other's backs.
